THE CN TESTED THE SUBSTANCE AND THE FIELD TEST INDICATED THE SUBSTANCE CONTAINED PCB OF OVER 50 PPM. APL, LTD DEPLOYED A RESPONSE TEAM TO CONTAIN THE SUBSTANCE. THE CARGO WAS FOUND TO BE SMALL RECEPTACLES CONTAINING A OILY SUBSTANCE, NOT METAL SCRAP. THE RECEPTACLES WERE PLACED IN SALVAGE DRUMS AND THE CONTAINER CLEANED. A SECOND SAMPLE OF THE SUBSTANCE HAS BEEN SUBMITTED TO A LAB TO VERIFY THE SUBSTANCE AND THE PCB CONTENT. TEST RESULTS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE 6/07/2013.

Report Description///NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: GULF OF MEXICO/// POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. REPORT DATE: 01-03-2023 REPORT TIME: 0945 UTC REGION: GULF OF MEXICO SUB REGION: N/A AREA/BLOCK: MAIN PASS 138 IMAGE DATE: 01-03-2023 IMAGE TIME: 0002 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL1A MODE: INTERFEROMETRIC WIDE (IW) VV RESOLUTION: 5X20 METER LOCATION: 29°21"02" N/88°49"35" W AREA: 27.57 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM-HIGH REMARKS: POSSIBLE, UNCONFIRMED OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THREE SEGMENTS OF BROKEN OIL WERE CENTERED LARGELY IN MAIN PASS. THE EASTERN SEGMENT WAS BROKEN AND EXTENDED 14.2 NM FROM SOUTH TO NORTH. THE SOUTHWEST SEGMENT WAS UNBROKEN AND EXTENDED 11.7 NMI FROM SOUTH TO NORTH. FINALLY, TWO SMALLER BROKEN ANOMALIES BETWEEN 5-8 NM EACH WERE LOCATED IN THE NORTHWEST QUADRANT. THE EASTERN AND SOUTHWESTERN SEGMENTS HAD VERY SHARPLY DEFINED EDGES. WINDS AT THE TIME WERE FROM THE SOUTH SOUTHEAST AT 15-20 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE EASTERN SEGMENT MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH NRC #1356597, BUT THE LOCATION OF THE OIL TO THE NORTH OF THE INCIDENT LOCATION ROUGHLY 6 HOURS AFTER THE REPORT TIME DOES NOT AGREE WITH THE OBSERVED MOTION OF THE SHEEN TOWARDS THE SOUTHEAST. IT IS UNKNOWN WHETHER ALL THE SEGMENTS HAD A SINGLE SOURCE OR IF THERE MIGHT BE MORE THAN ONE. MAPS AND SHAPEFILES CAN BE ACCESSED AT: WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ ERMA: HTTPS://ERMA.NOAA.GOV/GULFOFMEXICO/ERMA.HTML#/LAYERS=1+51167&X=-88.8190755&Y=29.330696&Z=11&PANEL=LAYER

HE WENT TO PUT THE SWITCH INTO THE BAG THE SWITCH FELL APART AND FELL ONTO THE FLOOR. HE INFORMED HIS FLOOR FOREMAN. THEY REMOVED ARTICLES OF CLOTHING AND SHOES, VENTILATED AND SECURED THE AREA AND NOTIFIED FACILITIES, SECURITY AND EVS AT THE SCH. THE MERCURY SPILL WAS CLEANED UP. VAPOR TESTS WERE PERFORMED. AREA WAS SECURED UNTIL CONTRACTED HAZARDOUS WASTE COMPANY GAVE THE ALL CLEAR ON JULY 25, 2012.
